doc: Earth-equivalent |latitude| (degrees) per row: min(|degrees(lat)| / hadley_deg * 30, 65) where 65 = EARTH_CAP_DEG - ZONE_DEG / 2 (past it the zones of Earth's ice-contaminated caps are replaced by the 62.5..67.5 zone). A slow rotator (edge at 60 degrees): the zones cover half the globe's span, none reach the cap. Rows: a 64-row grid then the poles pulled in by 1e-3 rad (|lat| = 90 would sit exactly on a zone edge for this edge), the equator, +-0.0, 1e-9, 0.5, 1.2, 1.5 rad. Float64 closed form: 1e-9.
